nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address checked by onlyOwner and rewritten by transferOwnership
Pausable.paused: pause flag gating whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers
ERC20Basic.totalSupply: total token supply, changed in _burn and mint
StandardToken.allowed: nested allowance mapping keyed by owner and spender
StandardToken.tokenBlacklist: address blacklist mapping checked in transfer/transferFrom
StandardToken.balances: balance mapping mutated by transfer, transferFrom, _burn, mint
ComfortNFT.name = "ComfortNFT" token name
ComfortNFT.symbol = "COMF" token symbol
ComfortNFT.decimals = 18 used for totalSupply scaling
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: reassigns owner
Pausable.pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused: sets paused = true
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused: sets paused = false
StandardToken.transfer(address,uint256): blacklist + balance checks then balance moves
StandardToken.balanceOf(address): view returning balances[_owner]
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): allowance based balance moves
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
StandardToken.allowance(address,address): view returning allowed[_owner][_spender]
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address,uint256): adds to the caller allowance
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint256): subtracts from allowance with clamp
StandardToken._blackList(address,bool): internal write to tokenBlacklist
ComfortNFT constructor: sets totalSupply, credits deployer balance and owner
ComfortNFT.burn(uint256): public burn entry that delegates to _burn(msg.sender,_value)
ComfortNFT._burn(address,uint256): reduces balance and totalSupply
ComfortNFT.mint(address,uint256) onlyOwner: adds amount to totalSupply and balances
PausableToken.blackListAddress(address,bool) whenNotPaused onlyOwner: delegates to _blackList
msg.sender: caller address used for authorization, allowance keys and balance keys
transfer arithmetic: balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value)
transferFrom arithmetic: balances[_from].sub, balances[_to].add, allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub
_burn arithmetic: balances[_who].sub(_value) and totalSupply.sub(_value)
mint arithmetic: totalSupply.add(amount) and balances[account].add(amount)
privileged assignment owner = newOwner inside transferOwnership
transferOwnership parameter newOwner: new privileged owner address
transfer parameter _to: recipient of the balance move
transfer parameter _value: amount subtracted and added
transferFrom parameter _from: owner whose balance and allowance are debited
transferFrom parameter _to: credit recipient
transferFrom parameter _value: amount moved and allowance reduced
approve parameter _spender: allowance key of the spender
approve parameter _value: allowance amount written directly
_burn parameter _who: account whose balance is destroyed
burn/_burn parameter _value: amount removed from balance and totalSupply
mint parameter account: credited address
mint parameter amount: amount added to supply and balance
blackListAddress parameter listAddress: address to blacklist/unblacklist
blackListAddress parameter isBlackListed: flag value written to the blacklist
decreaseApproval local oldValue: cached allowance before clamped subtraction
